user.title: Connect your GIOM weather station
user.description: Enter the address of the weather station on your network. Home Assistant reads it over HTTP; SNMP is detected automatically and adds two extra readings when available.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname, for example 192.168.0.100. IPv6 goes in square brackets.
data_description.community: Leave as 'public' unless you changed it in the station's own configuration page.

reconfigure.title: Update the station's address
reconfigure.description: Point the integration at the station's new address. Entities and their history stay untouched.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname, for example 192.168.0.100. IPv6 goes in square brackets.
data_description.community: Leave as 'public' unless you changed it in the station's own configuration page.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the station. Check the address and that its web interface is on port 80.
error.invalid_response: The address responded, but not with a GIOM status.xml. Make sure this is a GIOM weather station.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This station is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the station, in seconds.
data_description.use_snmp: Adds average wind speed and absolute pressure, which status.xml does not carry. Requires SNMP to be enabled on the station.
data_description.community: Only used when SNMP is switched on.
